hypotheses: Previously untested: separate mode-7 integer address construction from field displacement so MWCC cannot select the final addi/stbx addressing form. Confirmed: all six mode-7 stores now use add plus displacement stb, including the final two.
Previously untested: scale callback_index in place instead of introducing a distinct offset local. Confirmed: loop counter moves to retail r27 and score first rises to 96.92073.
Pointer-base-first versus scaled-offset-first address construction changes nonvolatile register coloring. Offset-first is best at 98.04878; base-first gives 98.018295.

Follow-up parameter types, helper inlining, address temporaries, selective store rewrites, volatile index reads, explicit lifetime unions, and control-flow spellings fail to improve the retained score. Detailed patches and raw measurements below identify each exact variant; rejected compile errors are retained honestly.
